page_note: Page contains two units. Unit 1 (segs 0-9): closing of a Wisdom/Mind correspondential teaching — sight/blindness mapped to having/lacking Nous, with Wisdom received only by those with Mind. This is substrate-quality correspondence. Unit 2 (segs 10-32): opens 'Concerning the Cross of Light' chapter. The apostolic frame and the disciple's question dominate. Embedded in the question is a quoted Cross of Light teaching (do not tread on the road lest you destroy hidden sprout / creeping thing) — genuine cosmological substrate about Light's suffering in matter — but the surrounding question is ecclesial (journey on Church business, teacher, foreign brothers, alms). Heavy damage (63.6%). Editorial fatigue shows ecclesial vocabulary rising in second half (+9.7) — matches the visible structure: ecclesial concerns dominate the disciple's question.
